HAMRAH MECHANIC · AUTOMOTIVE FINANCING

Clarity before commitment.

Applying for car financing meant navigating unfamiliar requirements and a disconnected survey. We brought the journey into the product and helped people understand what they needed before they applied.

My roleProduct Designer
CollaborationWith Parnia Parvizian
Case study publishedNovember 2024
The problemResearchDecisionsOutcomeReflection

The problem

An external survey interrupted the application journey. Information was not saved into back-office systems, and customers often reached the process without the required documents.

This was both a customer-experience problem and an operational one. Clarifying the interface had to go hand in hand with making applications useful for the teams handling them.

Understanding both sides

Working with Parnia Parvizian, we used stakeholder interviews, recorded sales calls, and usability testing to understand the points of confusion.

  • Seven users tested the previous flow.
  • Eight users tested the new flow.
  • Sales conversations helped reveal recurring questions about documents and financing conditions.

Make the commitment understandable

Keep the application in the product

Bring the financing flow into the main experience and connect it to back-office needs.

Explain requirements before the form

Help people understand the documents and conditions before asking them to invest time in an application.

Guide the unfamiliar steps

Add progress feedback, clearer financing conditions, and guidance around Sayadi checks, a local documentation requirement.

Parnia Parvizian and I worked together on the redesigned experience.

The reported results

33%

Conversion growth reported in the published case study.

The article also reports a 27% improvement in request quality, alongside reductions in operational effort.

Business outcomes are from the original project case study, linked below.

A better flow starts before the form

Helping someone apply successfully begins with preparing them for the decision. Requirements, conditions, and operational constraints are part of the experience—not details to explain after submission.

This project connected customer clarity with better information for the people processing each application.
